---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new tool, template, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is this related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem. E.g., "I'm frustrated when..."

**Describe the feature**
What you'd like to see added or changed.

**Which module does this relate to?**
- [ ] M1: Stylus (contracts, tests, compilation)
- [ ] M2: SDK (bridging, messaging)
- [ ] M3: dApp Builder (backend, frontend, indexer, oracle)
- [ ] M4: Orbit (chain config, deployment, validators)
- [ ] RAG / Knowledge Base
- [ ] Hosted Service (arbuilder.app)
- [ ] Other

**Example usage**
Show how you'd use this feature (example prompt, expected output, etc.)

**Additional context**
Any other details, references, or screenshots.
